title: The Well of the Hollow Moon
objective: Recover the hollow silver moon from the stone cup beneath the well and carry it out to daylight.

rooms.name: Well Mouth
rooms.description: Daylight whitens the broken well curb. Dry steps spiral down the inside of the shaft, level with the water's black mirror.

features.name: Drop a pebble
features.description: A thin silver moon hangs far below the rim, even at noon. Loose pebbles lie within reach.
features.discovery: A falling pebble breaks the reflection of the sky into rings. Watch what stays still as the ripples pass.

changed.description: The water reflects the sky all the way across. The hollow moon rests in your pack.

features.name: Chain groove
features.description: Twin grooves cut across the rim.
features.discovery: The grooves run down the inside wall beside a flight of dry steps.

rooms.name: Echo Lip
rooms.description: Wind whistles through two holes in the limestone parapet.

features.name: Listen at the vents
features.description: One hole smells of leather, the other of wet stone.
features.discovery: Claws scratch behind the northern vent. The other carries the sound of water slapping a basin.

features.name: Broken parapet
features.description: Through the broken parapet you can see the round belly beneath the silver crescent.
features.discovery: A sight line along the shaft points to a stone cradle far below.

changed.description: The gap gives a clear view of an empty stone cradle.

rooms.name: Gnawed Tithe Box
rooms.description: Splinters cover the floor under an oak drawer. Two rat runs meet at its foot.

features.name: Chewed drawer
features.description: Two wet grooves run from the drawer into a torn purse.
features.discovery: Eight coppers and two thin silver pieces have rolled under the runner.

features.name: Tooth marks
features.description: Paired grooves score the back panel.
features.discovery: The rats ate through from opposite sides and met in the purse.

items.name: Rat purse
items.description: Chewed leather holds a few brown coins and two thin silver pieces.

rooms.name: Split Basin
rooms.description: Water drips into a waist-high model of the well, split down its centre.

features.name: Model basin
features.description: A horn scoop hangs beside the intact half.
features.discovery: The scoop holds just enough water to lift the little float against its catch.

uses.text: Water lifts the model float. A pin draws back. Beside you a full-sized slab slides aside to reveal the Lip Stair.

features.name: Cutaway basin
features.description: A crack exposes the underside of the other cup.
features.discovery: A bright pin on the rising float draws a bolt sideways. The real well used the same linkage.

items.name: Horn scoop
items.description: A scoop worn thin from lifting water into the model.

rooms.name: Dry Niche
rooms.description: A shelf of dry stone sits above a tide of brittle leaves.

features.name: Sleeping shelf
features.description: The chalk above the shelf is powder dry.
features.discovery: The highest flood stopped a hand below this ledge. There is room to stretch out.

features.name: Spindle notch
features.description: One wall bears a deep circular rub.
features.discovery: Through the notch you can see a spindle still hanging from the rope pegs next door.

rooms.name: Rope Rack
rooms.description: Only the ends of the old ropes survive, neatly wound on their pegs.

features.name: Turn the spindle
features.description: One spindle turns freely in its socket.
features.discovery: Something tugs back from deep below. A little rust sifts down the shaft.

features.name: Empty peg hole
features.description: A square of grey light shows through the wall.
features.discovery: Through the hole you see the Lip Stair and the back of a sliding slab.

rooms.name: Tilted Gauge
rooms.description: A stone gauge leans into the shaft. Two white lines cross its face.

features.name: Read the water marks
features.description: One stripe is chalk, the other a hard crust.
features.discovery: The lower chalk stripe marks a safe working level. At the crusted line the inspection floors tilt and spill their load.

features.name: Sight along the index
features.description: The bent pointer still aims down the well.
features.discovery: A matching white stripe cuts across a treadle deep below.

rooms.name: Lip Stair
rooms.description: Cold air pulls down the spiral. Spent fly husks collect against the first riser.

features.name: Slab joint
features.description: A hairline seam outlines a slab beside the stair.
features.discovery: A rod runs from the slab towards the split basin. The regular stair goes down beside it.

features.name: Empty husks
features.description: The translucent shells stick to your fingertips.
features.discovery: A single fine thread joins every husk to the stair below.

rooms.name: Drip Landing
rooms.description: Water gathers on a low ceiling and falls in fat drops onto grey silk.

features.name: Watch the falling drops
features.description: Each falling drop plucks a strand along the direct passage.
features.discovery: A hairy foot darts out at each vibration. The north shelf leads to White Seam above the web.

changed.description: Drops pluck the slack strand. Nothing stirs above the curtain.

features.name: Dry shelf
features.description: Chalk crumbles under a clean strip of stone.
features.discovery: The shelf runs underneath a wooden bobbin without touching a strand.

rooms.name: Silk Curtain
rooms.description: Silk hangs in long sheets between the pillars. One taut strand leads north.

features.name: Woven knot
features.description: A tight knot sags under the thickest line.
features.discovery: Five gold pieces spill from the web around a long-empty beetle shell.

features.name: Signal strand
features.description: A single dark strand rises out of reach.
features.discovery: It leads back to the chalk spool at White Seam. The direct causeway beyond it has a loose lip.

items.name: Web gold
items.description: Tiny gold coins stick together in a wad of grey silk.

rooms.name: White Seam
rooms.description: A chalk seam rises past a wooden spool. An empty shell dangles from its thread.

features.name: Wind the lure
features.description: The spool pulls a husk towards a crack above the curtain.
features.discovery: The husk jerks into the crack. Anything following that signal will hunt up there, away from the curtain.

changed.description: The spool is wound tight. The lure hangs deep in the ceiling crack.

features.name: Air channel
features.description: White dust skims along a groove.
features.discovery: The current comes from a discharge pipe towards the Blind Spout.

rooms.name: Spider Loom
rooms.description: Layers of web stretch across a bronze filter. The bars sing under the tension.

features.name: Outer filter
features.description: A red glint shines behind the loose first layer.
features.discovery: A banded agate drops into your palm when you tease the silk aside.

features.name: Inner filter
features.description: The inner threads glint in even rows.
features.discovery: The teeth of a fine silver mesh comb have held this web for years.

items.name: Banded agate
items.description: A red agate striped with milky quartz.

items.name: Silver mesh comb
items.description: A fine-toothed silver comb chased with reeds.

rooms.name: Blind Spout
rooms.description: A pale circle shines at the far end of a discharge pipe.

features.name: Discharge pipe
features.description: Wind blows in past a fringe of fine roots.
features.discovery: The pipe slopes gently towards a daylight opening in the ravine wall.

features.name: Silken fringe
features.description: The silk towards Spider Loom quivers against the floor.
features.discovery: A large weight moves overhead on the other side of the filter.

rooms.name: Chalk Shelf
rooms.description: A dry chalk overhang juts above the stream. Little white shells roll across the floor.

features.name: Overhang
features.description: A bed of dry flakes crumbles softly underfoot.
features.discovery: The shelf stays dry between draws of the siphon. You can rest here.

features.name: Rolling husks
features.description: The line of husks moves a finger's width at a time.
features.discovery: Each intake carries the husks towards Siphon Bell and away from the web.

rooms.name: Siphon Bell
rooms.description: Air sighs through the flared mouth of a stone siphon.

features.name: Bell mouth
features.description: The mouth frames a narrow view of the sluice.
features.discovery: Dry flagstones run all the way to Sluice Stair outside the silk.

features.name: Flood rings
features.description: Two rings of brown husks cling inside the bell.
features.discovery: The lower ring meets the chalk stripe. The upper ring lies above the passage floor.

rooms.name: Sluice Stair
rooms.description: Water seeps down a smooth stair into a cave that smells of wet dog.

features.name: Overlapping prints
features.description: Broad pads overprint a smaller set.
features.discovery: At least two animals use the crossing below. Only the smallest tracks can be seen from the landing.

features.name: Dry stain
features.description: A crooked rust stain crosses the ceiling.
features.discovery: The streak points back to Siphon Bell, a landmark visible even from the lower steps.

rooms.name: Sluice Foot
rooms.description: The sluice empties into knee-deep water. Across it a spine of limestone rises into the dark.

features.name: Ford ripples
features.description: A set of prints ends abruptly at the waterline.
features.discovery: Beyond the ford a second, much larger animal has flattened the grass on the opposite bank.

features.name: Limestone spine
features.description: One rib stands clear of the current.
features.discovery: The stone stays dry from here to Rib Bridge, above both banks.

rooms.name: Rib Bridge
rooms.description: Stone ribs fan across a gap. One tread shifts as spray strikes its underside.

features.name: Test the tread
features.description: A loose stone sits at the edge of the direct crossing.
features.discovery: The stone makes the tread seesaw. The upper rib reaches Wind Pocket by a longer way.

features.name: Upper rail
features.description: Claw marks stop below the top of the rail.
features.discovery: From here you can follow the dry rib all the way past the dens.

rooms.name: Furrowed Ford
rooms.description: A rippled ford cuts between two banks of damp gravel. A broken saddlebag hangs in the reeds.

features.name: Split saddlebag
features.description: The strap is wedged in a forked root.
features.discovery: Forty stamped gold pieces gleam through a split in the lining.

features.name: Far bank
features.description: Deep pads press water up between the stones.
features.discovery: The two sets of tracks follow opposite banks, converging at the shallowest step.

items.name: Ford gold
items.description: Heavy coins rubbed smooth by the ford.

rooms.name: Winter Den
rooms.description: The cave floor rises in ridges of shed fur. The musk catches at the back of your throat.

features.name: Copper catches
features.description: Two tooth-scored catches show through the matted fur.
features.discovery: An old chest holds a wine-red garnet and a pale moonstone wrapped separately in felt.

features.name: Bedding hollows
features.description: Two broad hollows dent the ridge.
features.discovery: The hollows are equally deep. Both wolves sleep here.

items.name: Den garnet
items.description: A wine-red garnet in a square of felt.

items.name: Pale moonstone
items.description: A round stone with a floating blue sheen.

rooms.name: High Rib
rooms.description: A wrinkle in the limestone lifts the passage above the caves. Tiny shells stripe the wall.

features.name: Read the seam
features.description: Shells disappear under a fold of banded stone.
features.discovery: The deposit pinches around an old pocket in the rock.

success.text: A pale snail track curls around a loose stone. The pocket behind it holds a striped jasper.

features.name: Stone shoulder
features.description: A hump of limestone hides the ford from view.
features.discovery: From its crest you can count the beds in Winter Den without entering either hunting ground.

items.name: Seam jasper
items.description: A jasper striped with the colours of the high-water stain.

rooms.name: Daylight Fissure
rooms.description: A wedge of daylight shines through roots embedded in the rock.

features.name: Root chimney
features.description: Fine green roots sway in an uphill draught.
features.discovery: The chimney opens on a steep hillside well above the floodwater.

features.name: Fissure elbow
features.description: A shelf turns back towards the shaft.
features.discovery: The shelf meets Chain Stair without dropping to the den floor.

rooms.name: Wind Pocket
rooms.description: A crosswind whistles through a dry ledge high above the ford.

features.name: Windbreak
features.description: A stone lip shelters a flat patch of sand.
features.discovery: No tracks cross this sand. There is room for a dry bed behind the lip.

features.name: Listen at the bridge
features.description: An uneven tapping comes through a narrow slit.
features.discovery: There is a hollow note every time the bridge tread drops.

rooms.name: Chain Stair
rooms.description: A long chain taps the wall one link below a chalk stripe.

features.name: Knocking link
features.description: One link is polished bright on its outer face.
features.discovery: A wedge of fallen limestone has sheared the pin that joined the chain to the float. Half the pin still rattles in the last link.

features.name: Hooked feather
features.description: A white feather as wide as your palm catches on the grate.
features.discovery: One end has been crushed between beak and claw. Deep gouges run down the stairs.

rooms.name: Chain Foot
rooms.description: At the foot of the chain, white scratches curve through the silt towards a dial. Air stirs from a side cell.

features.name: Floor gouges
features.description: Three hooked lines score each side of a wide trail.
features.discovery: An animal too broad for the side cell dragged a large bone towards the dry arch.

features.name: Bench marks
features.description: A curved brass stain marks the side-cell threshold.
features.discovery: The stain matches the little float and cradle in the model upstairs.

rooms.name: Stillwater Cell
rooms.description: A dry stone bench faces a brass cradle. A ball the size of a plum rattles in its forks.

features.name: Stone bench
features.description: The bench sits above a stripe of old flood silt.
features.discovery: Even at high water this was a dry place to wait for the river to turn.

features.name: Float cradle
features.description: The forks hold a hollow brass ball on a short stem.
features.discovery: Its stem fits the pilot cup at Moon Dial. The striking face has been polished by years of releasing the catch.

items.name: Brass pilot float
items.description: A small stemmed float for the empty pilot cup.

rooms.name: Shed-Skin Gallery
rooms.description: A hanging moult nearly fills the arch. Beyond it, one of the flagstones tilts in a bed of silt.

features.name: Mineral crust
features.description: A patch of white crust bulges around a smooth bead.
features.discovery: A lustrous pearl comes free when the brittle crust breaks.

features.name: Split moult
features.description: The back of the husk divides at an odd angle.
features.discovery: These are two skins with their legs caught together. Two lines of fresh silk lead overhead.

rooms.name: Moon Dial
rooms.description: Water ticks around a bronze dial. Through the wide dry arch an owlbear's nest of white quills nearly blocks the way.

features.name: Pilot cup
features.description: A palm-sized cup sits beneath two water marks.
features.discovery: The empty cup is missing the brass pilot float. Its catch points towards Balance Tube. The dry arch is wide enough to admit an owlbear. A hooked feather is still wedged in the stone.

uses.text: The brass float lifts in the pilot cup. The hatch opens onto Balance Tube and the latch falls into place.

changed.description: The latch rests behind its tooth. The way to Balance Tube stands open.

features.name: Worn pivot
features.description: A bright hinge projects under the silt beside the dial.
features.discovery: The two water marks cross the pivot at different angles.

success.text: Your fingers follow the clean arc under the silt. The catch drops behind its tooth and the inspection hatch swings free.

features.name: Look through the dry arch
features.description: An owlbear sits on flattened reeds, cracking a long bone in its beak.
features.discovery: The arch passes right through the nest. A glint of gold shows between two reeds.

changed.description: The cleared nest lies open. Bone splinters litter the arch.

rooms.name: Blind Overflow
rooms.description: A cold draught carries the smell of wet leaves into a low spillway.

features.name: Floating seeds
features.description: Tiny winged seeds drift along the wall.
features.discovery: The water carries them under a curtain of hanging moss and out into daylight.

features.name: Spillway lip
features.description: The stone lip is smooth under the moss.
features.discovery: You can walk out here into the ravine with whatever you carry.

rooms.name: Nest of White Feathers
rooms.description: The floor gives under a mound of reeds and white feathers. Broad gouges cut into the rock around it.

features.name: Reed bed
features.description: A hard corner protrudes from under a tightly woven mat.
features.discovery: Beneath the nest is a hinged chart of hammered gold. Pinholes in its leaves trace the stars.

features.name: Cracked bones
features.description: A split thighbone juts out of the reeds.
features.discovery: The outer shell has been clipped straight through by a beak wider than your hand.

items.name: Gold star chart
items.description: Two hinged gold leaves pierced with the stars of the summer sky.

rooms.name: Balance Tube
rooms.description: A bronze tube runs through the wall. Its bore smells of river mud and cold metal.

features.name: Sight through the pivot
features.description: A circle of silver shines at the end of the bore.
features.discovery: The bore points straight at the cup around the bend. The pivot and the cradle belong to the same instrument.

changed.description: A circle of bare black stone fills the far end of the bore.

features.name: Inspection hatch
features.description: A bar runs from the hatch into the wall of Moon Dial.
features.discovery: When tripped, the latch drops behind a tooth. The way back stays open.

rooms.name: Moon Cup
rooms.description: Water ticks into a polished cup of black stone. A wide arch to the side smells of feathers and old blood.

features.name: Lift the float from the stone cup
features.description: A thread of water turns a melon-sized silver sphere between the black stone lips.
features.discovery: The cup's lifting fork rolls back against a padded stop. Two sockets in the bed of the cradle come into view.

changed.description: An empty cup of polished black stone rests below the dripping pipe.

features.name: Socket plate
features.description: A bronze tongue projects from under the lifting fork.
features.discovery: The fork and socket plate move together. Lifting the float exposes the two jewel bearings.

items.name: Hollow moon
items.description: A silver float as big as a melon, hammered from two thin shells.

items.name: Socket coral
items.description: A pink coral button cut to the curve of the silver float.

items.name: Socket tourmaline
items.description: A watermelon-green tourmaline from the second bezel.

passages.description: Dry steps descend inside the broken curb.
Small claws scrape at a splintered doorframe.
Drops follow a stone gutter into the basin.
A line of old leaves rims the dry passage.
Rope fibres cling to the peg-lined wall.
A broad walk skirts the back of the slab.
A white chalk stripe climbs the sloping wall.
The passage curls around the gauge shaft.
The model's slab has slid into a wall pocket.
Stone stairs spiral down beside the chain groove.
A dark web strand crosses the direct passage.
A dry chalk shelf passes above the web.
A chalk channel angles towards a patch of daylight.
Filter bars hum as silk rubs against them.

trap.name: Silk treadle
trap.description: A loose stone lip sticks up through the silk on the causeway.
trap.trigger: The silk pulls tight at your ankle and tips you onto stone.

passages.description: A loose stone lip sticks up through the silk on the causeway.
The fringe of the curtain gives way to open chalk.
Shells roll down the grade with each breath of air.
Dry flagstones curve outside the reach of the web.
The stone filter ends at the head of a stair.
A dark strand leads from the spool to the curtain.
Shallow water runs beside the descending stair.
Bare limestone rises above the surface of the ford.
Tracks of two sizes enter the reeds on opposite banks.
A stone rail follows the high side of the crossing.
Stiff roots lean towards a finger of daylight.
A sheltered ledge runs from the fissure to the chain.
Wind scours the upper rib clean of prints.

trap.name: Hollow tread
trap.description: One tread of the direct bridge rocks in its socket.
trap.trigger: The tread turns under your heel. You strike the stone rib below.

passages.description: One tread of the direct bridge rocks in its socket.
The damp gravel gives way to flattened ridges of fur.
Two beds of coarse grey fur block the lower path.
A draught passes the ledge and rattles the chain.
A stair turns beneath a ceiling scored by hanging links.
A dry threshold rises above the old water mark.
Three parallel gouges lead around the curve of the shaft.
Two fresh threads stretch from the arch to the ceiling.

trap.name: Sump treadle
trap.description: A rocking slab spans the sump under the gallery.
trap.trigger: The slab pivots and drops you hard into the stone sump.

passages.description: A rocking slab spans the sump under the gallery.
A trickle runs along a low spillway towards the ravine.
White quills fill the arch. An enormous hooked beak has bitten clean through a bone here.
Crushed reeds and split bones cover the threshold of the owlbear's nest.
An inspection hatch opens wide enough to crawl through.
A bronze sleeve runs from the pivot to a polished cup.

endings.title: A moon in daylight
endings.text: Daylight finds the silver ball dented and surprisingly light in your hands. Behind you the well holds only the sky. A last drop strikes the empty cup, four floors down.

endings.title: The well keeps its moon
endings.text: You reach daylight with your finds. Looking over the well curb, you can still pick out that thin silver crescent.

endings.title: Back at the rim
endings.text: You emerge with empty hands. The still crescent waits at the bottom of the well.

endings.title: Under the chalk line
endings.text: The sound of the river fills your ears. Far overhead the circle of daylight shrinks to a point.
